description: Ionic strength and Debye screening length of each LysK assay buffer
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Debye screening length kappa^-1 = 0.304 nm / sqrt(I[M]) for 1:1 salt at 25 C
def ionic_strength(species):  # list of (conc_M, z_cation, z_anion) treated as fully dissociated
    return 0.5*sum(c*(zc**2 + za**2) for c,zc,za in species)

buffers = {
 "Horgan turbidity: 50 mM Na-acetate pH 6.5"        : [(0.050,1,1)],
 "Donovan SLB: 150 mM NaCl + 10 mM Tris pH 7.5"     : [(0.150,1,1),(0.0045,1,1)],
 "Zymogram incubation: water"                        : [(0.0005,1,1)],
 "CAMHB (MIC): ~85 mM NaCl equiv + 0.55 mM Ca + 0.46 mM Mg + phosphate" : [(0.085,1,1),(0.00055,2,2),(0.00046,2,2),(0.005,1,1)],
 "TSB (plate lysis lawn / Sao-Jose TSBca)"           : [(0.085,1,1),(0.0005,2,2)],
}
rows=[]
for n,sp in buffers.items():
    I=ionic_strength(sp)
    rows.append(dict(buffer=n, ionic_strength_M=round(I,4), debye_nm=round(0.304/np.sqrt(I),2)))
db=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("debye_nm", ascending=False)
print(db.to_string(index=False))
db.to_csv("lysK_assay_ionic_strength.csv", index=False)

print()
print("Ratio of Debye length, Horgan acetate vs Donovan SLB: %.2fx"%(
   (0.304/np.sqrt(ionic_strength(buffers["Horgan turbidity: 50 mM Na-acetate pH 6.5"])))/
   (0.304/np.sqrt(ionic_strength(buffers["Donovan SLB: 150 mM NaCl + 10 mM Tris pH 7.5"])))))
print("Ratio of Debye length, Horgan acetate vs MIC broth:   %.2fx"%(
   (0.304/np.sqrt(ionic_strength(buffers["Horgan turbidity: 50 mM Na-acetate pH 6.5"])))/
   (0.304/np.sqrt(ionic_strength(buffers["CAMHB (MIC): ~85 mM NaCl equiv + 0.55 mM Ca + 0.46 mM Mg + phosphate"])))))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,3.6))
ax.barh(db.buffer, db.debye_nm, color=["#9ECAE1","#F58518","#4C78A8","#B279A2","#54A24B"])
for y,v in enumerate(db.debye_nm): ax.text(v+0.15,y,"%.2f nm"%v,va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Debye screening length (nm)")
ax.set_title("Electrostatic reach of a cationic endolysin toward the anionic wall,\nby the buffer each assay actually uses", fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=7.6); ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.3); ax.set_xlim(0,16)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
